name: Wind Chimes With Glass Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Best Material: The Glass Ornament is crafted from high-quality glass, designed to capture sunlight and create stunning visual effects. Its vibrant colors and intricate patterns make it a focal point in any garden or room. The metallic tubes of wind chimes are corrosion-resistant, ensuring long-lasting performance.
  • Beautiful Design: The wind chimes feature an elegant and intricate design, with metallic tubes that produce a melodious and calming sound as they sway in the breeze. The attached suncatcher adds a vibrant and colorful element, catching and reflecting sunlight to create beautiful light patterns.
  • Soothing Sounds: The wind chimes are carefully tuned to produce a harmonious and tranquil sound, creating a peaceful ambiance in your home or garden. The gentle melodies can help reduce stress and promote relaxation.
  • Versatile Use: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, these wind chimes can be hung in gardens, patios, balconies, or even inside your home near windows. They make a beautiful addition to any space, adding both auditory and visual appeal.
  • Perfect Gift: The Wind Chimes with Glass Ornament make a thoughtful and unique gift for friends, family, or loved ones. Whether for birthdays, housewarmings, or special occasions, this decorative piece is sure to be appreciated and cherished.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wind Chimes With Glass Ornament

 

PRODUCTION

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
